summary: Tested daily check-in popup, week-1/14-day trend pages, PDF exclusion of Plan/Track, Track page tracker + auto rows, and PATCH progress validation. All requested features work. Simulated time by creating rohan reports via API and backdating created_at (0.5h/30h/36h->60h/8d/15d). Only minor issues found.

minor.issue: ticks are not checked for format: strings like 'garbage' or '9-99' are accepted (200). logged_days can also contain duplicates like [1,1]. Only list length (<=70) is checked.

ui_bugs.issue: The '14-day plan · N/70 ticks' count comes from the /reports list (reports[0].ticks), not from the `latest` state. It stays out of date after saving the daily popup until the page is reloaded.

issues: The dialog runs to the screen edges with no side margin
When there are 0 ticks, the write-up says 'You kept all five activities at a similar rhythm (0/7 days each)', which reads oddly
The insights use short names ('Wake', 'Phone away') while the table uses full activity names

passed_tests: Popup shows on /dashboard for a 36h-old latest report ('How did Day 1 go?') and for a 60h-old report with logged_days [0] ('Day 2')
Popup does not show for a 0.5h-old latest report
The 5 questions render; data-mood goes up on Yes (+0.11) and down on No (-0.06); goes down to 0.15 after 5 No answers; mood-meter is visible
Save sends PATCH {ticks:['0-0','2-0','3-0'], logged_days:[0]}; popup does not come back after reload
Remind me later sets the sessionStorage key; popup stays hidden after reload and after SPA navigation, and comes back once sessionStorage is cleared. Escape/X also dismisses
Double-clicking Yes does not skip a question
Saving all-No removes only that day's ticks and keeps ticks from other days

Report sections: 0d has no week pages; 8d has report-page-week-1 and its nav item; 15d has week-1 and week-2 with trend-table, trend-insights and trend-next-step. Computed stats match the seeded ticks/moods/tracker (7/35 20%, 9/35, Rough->Steady, feel 4->7)
PDF page counts: 15d = 11 (13 in-app), 8d = 10 (12), 0d = 9 (11). Rendered PDF pages checked: Week 1 is page 7/11, the trend page follows, and there are no Plan/Track pages
Track page: tracker-explainer visible; tracker-0-0..1-3 save on blur and persist after reload; tracker-auto-0..4 show week 1/week 2 tick counts and update live when a plan cell is ticked
Backend: logged_days [-1], [14], [0,20], [100] and ['x'] return 422; valid save persists; tracker update leaves logged_days alone; >70 ticks returns 422; another student's report returns 404
action_items: (Low) LatestCard should count ticks from `latest` (or update reports[0] in saveLatest) so the count refreshes after the popup saves
(Low) Optionally check tick format with a regex like ^[0-4]-([0-9]|1[0-3])$ and remove duplicate logged_days on the server
(Low) Give the daily dialog a side margin on mobile; improve the Week 1 write-up wording when nothing was done
critical_code_review_comments: pendingDay only asks about the most recent day (e-1); days the student missed before that are never asked about again. This may be intended.
Tracker inputs accept any text (the 1-10 range is not enforced); trendInsights treats non-numbers as missing, so nothing breaks.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows (1 minor stale-count bug)

seed_data_creation: Created 4 rohan reports plus their assessments for UI testing and 1 for pytest; all deleted by id. The 4 protected reports were not touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use tests/ui_setup_reports.py <hours_ago...> to create backdated rohan reports (ids go to /tmp/ui_ids.txt), 'set <id> <json>' to patch a report in mongo, and 'cleanup' to delete them. pytest.ini uses xdist. The system clock is 2026-11-09 and rohan's protected report b456a01f is about 3.7 days old, so backdated reports only become the latest if they are younger than that.
